A '''battle''' at [[Reytha]] was an engagement during the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] liberation campaign after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]]. In the [[Time/Legends|year]] [[6 ABY/Legends|6 ABY]],<ref name="Atlas" /> the New Republic sent part of the [[New Republic Third Fleet|Third Fleet]] under the command of [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Willham Burke]]<ref name="Warfare" /> from [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] into the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]], where they attacked the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Reytha]].<ref name="Atlas" /> Admiral Burke commanded the naval forces, while [[General/Legends|General]] [[Brenn Tantor]] led the ground forces to a victory over the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperials]].<ref name="Warfare" /> Upon learning of the defeat at Reytha, Imperial forces abandoned the nearby planets [[Gyndine/Legends|Gyndine]] and [[Cyrillia/Legends|Cyrillia]] and retreated to the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]].<ref name="Atlas" />
